parties.respondent: M/S Steel Authority of India & Anr Etc.

summary: Royalty under MMDR Act: not a tax but payment for mineral extraction; nature of mining lease; interpretation of constitutional entries; fiscal federalism; public trust doctrine; state powers on mineral taxation vs Central regulation; royalty distinct from mineral rights duty; Entry 54 (List I) prevails over Entry 23 (List II) for central control on mineral development; final interpretation favors central regulatory framework.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; royalty determined under MMDR Act sustained as non-tax; regulatory primacy of Centre affirmed.
